final: {"prompt": "A square abstract painting filling the entire image edge to edge, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting. Purely nonrepresentational: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Palette: deep indigo and near-black ground, interrupted by veins of hot vermilion and ochre, with cool silver-blue threads running through the dark. Composition: a dense, layered mass of overlapping translucent strata in the center, pulled toward a few sharp, bright collisions of color, with loose open passages of bare ground around them for breath. Brushwork: energetic and visible, mixing sweeping dry-brush drags, thick impasto ridges, and fine scraped lines that cross each other in tension. Gesture: fast, searching arcs that double back on themselves, suggesting rapid thought that keeps revising. Texture: alternating smooth glazed areas and rough, granular surfaces, with occasional drips and splatter. Rhythm: repeated diagonal pulses that accelerate toward the upper right and then settle into slower, quieter bands at the lower left. Spatial tension: some forms press forward while others recede into shadow, with no clear foreground or background. Keep the mood intense yet contemplative, honest and unpolished, with contrast between crowded density and empty space."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
